Polymarket odds were about 42% that Iran would declare Khamenei's successor by March 2, 2026, with markets suggesting higher odds (81%) by March 31, 2026.
Actuarial Life Table shows annual death probability for exact age 86 is 0.105829 (10.58%), which translates to a rough 0.92% chance of death in one month.
